$comment: Phase B eval gates, declared BEFORE the atomic re-index build (D-012 protocol). Human record: issue #85 verdict comment (2026-07-22). Consumed by `pnpm eval --gate`.

nonRegression.$comment: Existing kinds with markers now inside chunk text. Gate compares per-query Hit@1 vs the baseline report; every dropped query must be explained in the report regardless of gate color.

figureCaption.$comment: New kind: caption semantic search (target: figures). RU-monolingual queries (2) are inside this gate; cross-lingual caption queries are ungated diagnostics (known unweighted-RRF pathology, fixed by the 06-seam effort).

figureNegative.$comment: Active only once the figures cosine floor is calibrated (two-tier: fixture tier mandatory — 100% flagged, zero positives zeroed; live tier decides ENABLING only, never the release). `active` is the machine flag for that condition — flip it together with FIGURES_SEMANTIC_FLOOR.

filterLayer.$comment: #93 filter param (D-019), declared BEFORE implementation (D-012). The semantic filter is candidate-set restriction before exact brute-force cosine/topK — a pure subset of the unfiltered ranking, no ANN recall loss is possible — so no new gated query kind. Gate = (a) the unfiltered suite must not regress: the existing nonRegression block vs baselineReport re-run after the filter layer lands; (b) mandatory unit property tests: restricted searchLibrary/searchLibraryFts return exactly the unfiltered ranking intersected with the allow set, order preserved. Human record: issue #93 resolution comment.

liveEval.$comment: Before/after diff on the real library is a mandatory triage artifact, NOT a gate — live-relevance.json labels are unverified and the re-index mixes markers + figures + D-016 demotion.

embedderBakeoff140.$comment: #140 embedder bake-off gates, declared + committed BEFORE any candidate run (D-012 protocol). Stack: transformers.js 4.3.1 / onnxruntime-node 1.30 (#139 branch) for EVERY candidate incl. the e5 baseline (re-measured, not the 2026-07-08 numbers). EN gate numbers mirror #142's rrfWeightSweep fixture gates (declared 2026-10-21 on claude/dreamy-mcclintock-39cefb; #142 had published no results/selected weight when these were committed, so the weight is swept here too). Live measurements are NOT gated: a gemma2 live index needs a full-library re-embed (~313k chunks at ~3 chunks/s ≈ 30 h; even the 269 labeled books are ~109k chunks), so the live before/after stays the mandatory post-re-index triage artifact (thresholds.liveEval). Consumed by test/eval/retrieval/bakeoff-140.ts.

measurements.fixtureOn: fixture, reranker ON (shipped default) — all modes at w=1.0, hybrid at the other weights
measurements.fixtureOff: fixture, --rerank off — isolates embedder + fusion (the order users get when the reranker is unavailable/busy, #156)

embedderBakeoff140.operatingPoint: Per model, apply #142's selection rule to its OWN sweep (fixture-only): among weights whose hybrid EN kinds (exact-identifier, front-matter-trap) drop <= 0.01 nDCG@10 with zero broken Hit@1 vs that model's w=1.0 (fixtureOn AND fixtureOff), pick max fixtureOff hybrid RU-involved nDCG@10; ties -> smaller weight. Candidates are compared to e5 at e5's operating point.

G1_ruGain.$comment: Target axis. fixtureOn e5 already saturates RU (1.000 in the July validation), so On may only not drop.

G3_enNonRegression.$comment: vs e5 at the operating points. Overall = negatives excluded (report.overall).

G4_zeroBroken.$comment: Existing nonRegression gate (thresholds.nonRegression vs baselineReport) on fixtureOn at w=1.0, hybrid + vector. If the e5-4.3.1 baseline itself fails it (ORT drift), that is a #139 finding (re-baseline at the re-index) and candidates are judged per-query vs e5-4.3.1 instead.

G5_throughput.$comment: Embed-only warm chunks/s on a fixed deterministic passage sample, q8, BATCH as the indexer uses. Other sessions load the CPU, so models run INTERLEAVED (e5, gemma2, e5, gemma2, ...) >= 3 rounds; gate on the median ratio. q4 measured informationally if the q4 weights are cheap to fetch. Reported as NOISY.

G6_ops.license: MIT or Apache-2.0 (D-013 would also admit Gemma terms; gemma2 is Apache-2.0)

floors.semanticFloor: Per model, from fixtureOff vector-mode library-scope maxScore at w=1.0: if every negative's maxScore < every positive's, floor = midpoint of the gap (rounded to 0.01); else the value flagging all 6 negatives while flagging the fewest positives. Reported with the positive/negative ranges; informational for e5 (0.78 stays unless the drift moved it out of the gap).
floors.RERANK_FLOOR: Reranker is embedder-independent but ORT 1.30 moves its logits (#139). From fixtureOn rows (hybrid+vector, library-scope): check every negative's maxRerank < 0.3 and count positives below 0.3; change only if a negative crosses 0.3 or the separation midpoint moved by > 0.1.

embedderBakeoff140.selection: Recommend a swap only if a candidate passes G1-G6 at its operating point. Among passing candidates prefer gemma2-256 over gemma2-768 when its G1/G3 numbers are within 0.01 (3x smaller vectors). Otherwise recommend keeping e5-small (and whether the 4.3.1 bump + its forced re-index still makes sense on its own).
